scope: Minimum per-round trace retention checklist for future SkillGen full/refinement runs
retention_policy: Do not delete or overwrite verification/round_* directories after selecting the final skill.
Store round artifacts under target/model/run-specific directories so retries cannot replace earlier evidence.
Every future full-matrix or Figure 7 run must fail validation if a required trace file is missing.
A parsed aggregate may be regenerated from raw traces, but raw traces must remain the primary evidence.

checks.purpose: Recompute baseline outcomes and identify cases repaired by candidate skills.
Recompute with-skill outcomes and identify regressions.
Read paired_n, accuracy, repair, regression, net_gain, and gate pass/fail per round.
Preserve per-case repair/regression explanations for audit and Figure 7 debugging.
Link each round's result to the candidate skill that was evaluated.
Preserve benchmark, model, dataset, config, route, and execution metadata for grouping.
Support token-cost and runtime diagnostics without mixing them into Figure 7 accuracy.
